HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

4. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Participation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.
   C. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Participation.

5. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.

6. Which statement about Linguistic groups in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Linguistic groups in Kenya.
   C. Say Linguistic groups in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Linguistic groups in Kenya as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Elections in Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.

8. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs

9. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.
   C. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.
   C. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.
   D. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   C. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain American Revolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain International organisations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Modern slavery and servitude Page 15 of 75 xiii 3.4 Global governance 3.5 1st Ge and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Modern Slavery and Servitude and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
